Travel India One Day is a premier tour and travel company based in Delhi, India, specializing in providing tours across the country. Our focus is on inbound tourism, catering to international travelers who are looking to explore the rich and diverse cultural heritage of India. Our experienced team of travel experts provides personalized travel itineraries that cater to your specific interests, needs, and budget. We offer a wide range of tours, including cultural, historical, adventure, and wildlife tours, with expert local guides to ensure that you have an authentic and immersive experience. With our comfortable transportation and hassle-free travel arrangements. Experience the best of India with Travel India One Day.

Upon our arrival in India, Raj introduced himself and helped us book our 32 days here. He was very knowledgeable about how best to organise travel around the country and since it was our first time here we knew very little.

Since booking with Raj we have spent the last 5 days with one of the kindest and loveliest drivers, Sanjay. I would recommend him to anyone. He was so thoughtful about our budget and desires. He is also very knowledgable and always helped to educate us on the culture, food and language, which I loved. He made our golden triangle trip one I will never forget. Dhanyavaad!

I must admit that as a backpacker the total for our hostels and transport etc was above my budget. In fact was what I planned to spend for the whole trip! Bearing in mind I still have to pay for food and entry fees (despite being cheap, there are a lot of!).
However, the quality and ease of our journey so far has been lovely. Not quite the backpacker experience, if that is what you are after, but I’m sure if you asked Raj he could accommodate. Also Raj has been checking in with us regularly on our trip so far which we really do appreciate!

I have to say that for the experience we have had with Sanjay so far, paying that bit extra has been totally worth it.

I will update after our whole trip has been completed! We are excited to see some more of India.

If you are looking for a company to help make your Indian holiday dream a reality, look no further than Travel India One Day. My Travel Agent- Amit Kalia- was incredibly helpful, refining my itinerary and assisting me move from place-to-place via personal driver and overnight trains. Before coming to India, I was anxious about travelling around after hearing how difficult it can be booking transportation. Amit immediately put my fears at bay and took on the heavy lifting, booking my trains around North and South India, and ensuring I had a driver to take me from Delhi, Rajasthan and Agra. He even booked me fantastic accomodation within my budget. Amit was able to meet my needs as a solo backpacker and is a big reason why I have enjoyed my time in India. He has kept up to date with my last minute itinerary changes and made sure I had a place to stay every night. If you are looking for somebody to help plan your dream trip to India, I would highly recommend Amit Kalia and the Travel India One Day Team.

Overall excellent experience. Raj helped us organized our 10 day trip in India quickly and seamlessly when we arrived in Delhi. Everyone at the hostel/agency were very kind and friendly too. Sanjey was our driver and he was amazing!! He drove us from Delhi to Agra to Jaipur to Pushkar safely and insured our comfort the entire way. He even took us to incredible local, cheap and delicious food- this was basically a sightseeing tour+food tour, which my husband and I loved. The trip included taj tickets and guide, 2 train tickets, driver, all transfers, 3 star hotels and breakfast, flight, and camel safari with meals but tips/entry fees to other monuments not included. For us, this tour was very much worth the price and we would recommend highly.

I arrived in India with well planned and pre booked itinerary. Jahn at Yes Boss Hostel by Backpackers Heaven rather ambushed me on arrival and said if I wanted to see the real India he could rearrange. Somewhat pushy but I agreed. He took over everything including cancelling all my tickets, getting refunds and making new itinerary and bookings including driver, hotels/hostel booking, guides at some locations , internal flights and train tickets . All more expensive than my own plans by 50% but on balance I’m pleased I did . Missed out staying at some hostels I wanted (he booked mostly hotels but they were generally nice) and experiences on bus travel, but that was possibly my fault for not being more ‘bossy’ back in the original replanning. Also you don’t always need Guides. For instance the Royal Palace at Udaipur has a perfectly good audio guide. The other criticism was that I found it difficult to get detailed schedule out of Jahn of new itinerary, hotel, train and flight bookings - sometimes felt the driver knew more than I did about plans! To return to positives,  I am very grateful for incurring the cost and services of a driver. My first 10 days were with Anil. His English is good but you have to tune in to his dialect and sentence construction. He has lots os stories and explanations about virtually anything you want to know about India! His driving is steady on a chaotic road system and made me feel safe. He was very amenable to stopping at any point for photos etc, gave good advice on value for money eateries, good guidance on tipping and how much certain things should cost eg tuktuk ride. He also knows where to see real India which I would not have achieved by car and flight alone. Without all this from Anil, India as a first time visitor would have been very stressful with each, even the smallest of journeys, being an epic!

Later:
Three weeks in to my trip I thought it would be useful to reflect and update. Everything has worked out as Jahn had promised and where I asked for changes, he implemented them quickly and without fuss. Jahn has become very good at checking in with me to make sure all ok and that there were no problems needing sorting. He was right - I have seen more of India than I would have done under my own steam. So yes, more expensive but no regrets and would recommend his services. Still a week to enjoy!

Amit was able to organize our stay while meeting our expectations. He was able to make himself available whenever we needed and regularly checked in on us. He was able to react professionally throughout the entire stay. For a peaceful stay, I recommend going through these services. Thank you again Amit!

Had an incredible time under the organisation of Zahid and with Sanjay driving myself and my friend  through Rajastan and Utter Pradesh over the course of 9 days.

Zahid did a great job of tightening up our itenerary in Dehli while Sanjay was incredibly attentive and helpful over the 9 days we spent with him.

After leaving Dehli we were guided through Agra, Ranthanbore, Jaipur and Udaipur where we were shown all the sites.

Highlights include seeing the Taj Mahal, seeing wild tigers in Ranthanbore and Sanjay providing us with constant beers on the long drive.

Definitely an unforgettable experience and I'll confidently book through this team again.

I cannot recommend booking with Travel One Day India enough. We booked two excursions with Raj and Rikki- a walking and food tour of Old Delhi with Danish, and a 4 day epic trip with Ghoki traveling privately from Delhi - Agra - Jaipur seeing all the sights all the sights along the way. We saw the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, (tickets covered as part of the price) and stayed in 3 star hotels which were decent with breakfast included.
The private tour with Ghoki was the highlight of our trip through India. He was a great driver and we felt safe the entire trip. He was also a fantastic guide, frequently pulling over to take amazing pictures thoughtout the trip and giving advice as to wether we need guides and how much to pay for things.. He was so friendly, and knowledgeable about all things India and there was never any of those awkward quiet moments. For the price we cannot rate the experience enough. He quickly became a friend!
The food tour with Danish was also fantastic, we enjoyed a 3/4 hour tour of Old Delhi stopping off at stops that the average Western tourist would miss. We went away do culturally enriched and with full bellys - certainly recommend!
Thank you to all the staff associated with Travel India One Day!

If this is your first time in India read carefully. As most of the people I met Raj in Backpack hostel. We paid a LOT of money for a 3 weeks tour, he planned everything but we didn’t know anything about India and I take responsibility of that.  In general we paid a LOT LOT LOT MORE. And this is normal, because scams are normal in India. Raj also is very friendly of course because he wants your money so only be aware of that.
In general the tour was okay, 3 stars hotels mostly, some good some better, all had AC ✅. Sunjay was our driver and he is amazing 🤩. In general the tour was fine, the price included bed, breakfast and the car with the driver, 2-3 train tickets (later I discovered how to buy them by my own and I’m sure again I paid a lot more with Raj).
The car was perfect, AC and Bluetooth. The bad part, again, was paying a lot of money 💰 because of course we had to pay the entry to every single temple, museum, fort, the tips are a very big thing in India and also we had to pay the food for lunch and dinner. I’m not sure if part of the money goes to all the people involved, for me the person who takes the more is Raj.
You can get the same tour for LESS.
Part of the deal was that Raj was going to pay for my hostel on my lasts days in India, I tried to talk with him when I was in Delhi again after my whole stay finished but he only ignored.
I love India with all my heart, I would only change that people involved in tourism don’t see foreigners as a bag of money.
